request.subject: ICON:ACTION:SUMMON_IMP

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: a single item sprite shown whole and centred on a transparent background, a slight three-quarter angle looking a little down, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Faction: a pulp-magazine secret society of the 1920s, mock-sinister, silly and never scary. Their fixed colours: soft midnight indigo cloth shaded deeper violet-blue, never black; pale cream candle wax and parchment; small pieces of warm polished brass; and exactly one accent colour, a bright glowing spring green, only as small flames and glows: candle flames, lamp glass, an eye-in-a-spiral sign.
layers.negative: blood, gore, guts, dripping, horror, creepy realism, slime, skull, bone, black cloth, grey cloth, torn cloth, ragged hems, purple, violet, magenta, pink, red cloth, red robe, orange flames, yellow flames, blue flames, gold armour, chrome, steel armour, sword, gun, pentagram, cross, large glowing area

layers.text: Class: one bold chunky item sprite with a single clear subject and a big simple silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone, very few details; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels. The item floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it.
layers.negative: icon frame, round badge, medallion, emblem, coin-shaped backdrop, button, border, circular background, square background, vignette, background scenery, ground tile, grass square, pedestal, many small objects, text, letters, numbers

layers.text: Subject: one low ring of pale grey stone seen at an angle, like a hoop lying flat, and rising out of its middle the head and shoulders of a small rubbery deep-sea teal imp with one big round pale yellow eye, a wide cheeky cream grin, two small pointed ears and two tiny bat wings; simple shapes and very few details.

The imp has only one single big round pale yellow eye in the middle of its face, a cyclops, and a crest of three small teal spikes on top of its head instead of ears. The ring is pale grey stone. Its head is big and fills the upper half of the image.
layers.negative: grass, ground tile, slab, platform, person, character, checkerboard, dark background, two eyes, goblin, long ears, horns, fire, flames, candle, blue cloth, pink, red, tongue
